Name: Buy Unique Furniture from Qi's Casino
Author: skrunklysappho
Description:
Gunther gives out some lovely furniture items and decorations in return for donating items to the museum, but you can only ever have just one of most of them! What if you want 'Jade Hills' in your shed [i]and[/i] your farmhouse? How about a singing stone or bear statue on both sides of a room? And, really, what is one supposed to do with only [i]one[/i] crystal chair?

[b]This mod adds most of Stardew Valley's pesky one-of-a-kind furniture items to the casino shop in Calico Desert.[/b]
[b]They will only be available for sale once the original has been found by whatever means it is found in vanilla.[/b] (The exception to this is the 'Boat' painting, as it is entirely unobtainable outside of the Beach farm type.)
All of these items cost casino coins, with prices balanced around the vanilla casino offerings. All of the vanilla casino items are still available! However, 'Burnt Offering' will not be available until the original has been obtained as a museum reward, to match all of the new stock added by this mod.

[b]Why Qi's Casino?
[/b]Qi's Casino already sells the 'Burnt Offering' museum reward, so I thought it was a fitting place to add the rest. The casino also doesn't have much of a reason to go there in vanilla outside of alien rarecrows, so this gives it more of a purpose.~

The following furniture items are added to the Casino shop once they have been obtained as museum rewards:
[b]- 'A Night On Eco-Hill'
- 'Jade Hills'
- Lg. Futan Bear
- Bear Statue
- Standing Geode
- Singing Stone
- Obsidian Vase
- Crystal Chair
- Skeleton Statue
- Chicken Statue
- Sloth Skeleton L
- Sloth Skeleton M
- Sloth Skeleton R[/b]

The following additional secret items are also added to the museum stock:
[b]- 'Boat'[/b] (Available by default, as the original cannot be obtained outside of the Beach farm type otherwise)
[b]- Junimo Plush[/b] (Once the original has been obtained by following Secret Note #13)
[b]- Iridium Krobus[/b] (Once the original has been fished up. It costs a whopping 50,000 casino coins to offset its special nature; this is as much as five alien rarecrows!)

The following items were NOT added to the shop for various reasons.
[b]- Stardew Hero Trophy and Soda Machine[/b] (Rewards for completing the game's first big challenge; I don't want to cheapen their value)
[b]- Solid Gold Lewis[/b] (Tied to another secret)
[b]- ??HMTGF??, ??Pinky Lemon?? and ??Foroguemon??[/b] (Can already be obtained multiple times by repeating the steps to obtain them)
[b]- Stone Junimo[/b] (Can already be obtained multiple times, as it respawns every Spring 2)
[b]- Rarecrows #7 and #8[/b] (Can already be obtained multiple times, by purchasing them at the Night Market, one per year)
[b]- Stone Owl, Strange Capsule and Empty Capsule[/b] (Can already be obtained multiple times, as their secret events repeat)

[b]Compatibility[/b]
This mod replaces the casino's default stock in order to make 'Burnt Offering' require the original to be unlocked first. As such, it may be incompatible with other mods that do the same.

Manifest.Description: Buy unique furniture items from the museum rewards and secret notes from Qi's Casino!
